answer:
This seems to work, a new day and fresh ideas.

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession, functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from datetime import datetime
import re

# 1. Define base path where timestamped folders are stored
base_path = "abfss://<Workspace>@onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/<Lakehouse name>.Lakehouse/Files/Landing/"
folder_prefix = "<folder name>"

# Use Spark to load all CSVs with wildcard
df = spark.read.option("header", True).csv(base_path + "*/part-*.csv")  # or *.csv

# Extract full path column (use input_file_name)
from pyspark.sql.functions import input_file_name

df_with_path = df.withColumn("source_file", input_file_name())

# Get distinct directory names
dir_names = df_with_path.select("source_file").distinct().rdd.map(lambda row: row[0].rsplit('/', 2)[-2]).distinct().collect()

print(dir_names)

latest_folder = sorted(dir_names)[-1]

print(f"Latest folder: {latest_folder}")
